policy: Every 3D asset must be declared here before use. Current implementation uses only project-authored procedural geometry and materials.

assets.name: Reference-guided procedural battlefield set
assets.author: MIRROR project
assets.notes: Foot archer pawns, horse archer knights, advisor bishops, war chariot rooks, war elephant commander queens, royal commander kings, terrain, board rails, fort/camp silhouettes, rocks, sparse trees, banners, off-board soldiers, horses, elephants, chariots, ambient dust, non-gory impact rings/sparks/dust. This is a reference-guided procedural prototype, not final realistic 3D art.
